Ethan: hey team, Ethan here. first on-call this week. quick checklist of things i hit and a couple process q's.
Lila: welcome Ethan! :wave: what tripped you up?
Ethan: 1) can't clone runbooks repo, gitlab denies me with 403. i requested access but not sure who approves.
ops-iam: approvals come from the owning team. for runbooks open an access request at https://gitlab.com/groups/runbooks/-/access_requests and tag @dave or the listed owner in the MR. i'll also add you to the "runbooks-read" group now.
Ethan: thanks. 2) i want to do a dry-run simulated page but i'm nervous about triggering automatic rollback hooks in infra. do sims trigger rollbacks?
dave: sims are safe. we have a flag on the PD integration so simulated incidents do not trigger automation. real incidents can hit automation if a runbook step calls the rollback play. always read the runbook top section for automation notes.
Ethan: good to know. 3) when paged, does the incident channel include a rollout tag or just the service name?
Lila: PD creates #incidents/<service>-<id>. if the incident references a deploy it appends the deploy tag in the first post. we also have a bot reaction for "requires-rollback" :warning: so you can spot it fast.
Ethan: onboarding process q: after a Sev2, who drafts the initial postmortem? primary oncall or EM?
Lila: primary oncall drafts the incident summary and timeline within 24h. EM + SRE lead finalize the full postmortem within 72h. there's a short template in Confluence.
Ethan: got it. 4) i saw a runbook command that uses `redwoodctl rollback --auto`. should i ever run that manually?
dave: avoid `--auto` unless the runbook explicitly says so. prefer `redwoodctl rollback --interactive` so you confirm targets. `--auto` is reserved for emergency automation when the runbook author marked it safe.
Ethan: buddy question: can i shadow someone? want a safety net for first couple pages.
sre-training: yes — shadowing is available. assign a buddy by DMing @sre-training or use the shadow signup sheet at https://internal.redwood/shadow-signup. we'll attach the shadow flag so PD shows "shadow:Ethan".
Ethan: last: any small CLI snippets i should memorize?
Lila: keep these handy:
- check pods: `kubectl -n svc get pods`
- recent deploys: `gitlab-ci get deploys --service svc`
- emergency rollback (interactive): `redwoodctl rollback --interactive svc`
- fetch runbook top: `curl -s https://runbooks.redwood/svc/latest | sed -n '1,120p'`
Ethan: perfect. i'll request runbooks access now and schedule a simulated page for 04:00 UTC. i'll ping here when i run it.
oncall-bot: Tip: complete the oncall quickstart and sign the oncall acknowledgement form: https://internal.redwood/oncall-ack
Ethan: thanks everyone, appreciate the help!
